# E88 pilot gates, written 2026-11-02 before any pilot below ran

Written by Claude from plans/large/E88.md section 6 and the defaults for section 11. Nothing here may be
changed after its pilot starts. Later notes go in the plan's dated section, not here.
At the time of writing: P1 has run; no TIFF is on disk; no network has been trained; no full model fitted.

## Rules for every job
- CPUs: at most logical CPUs 0-9,11-13, which is 13 CPUs. The plan's "14 workers" and "15-core CPU" cannot
  be met under the safety stop, so both are run on 13 and the gate is judged at 13 with no scaling.
- Before each job: /sys/devices/system/cpu/offline reads 10,26, and the machine-check count is 1.
- Long jobs: detached, under tools/memguard.py with a stated cap, checkpointed through bigrun, gpu_lock for GPU.
- Keep 30 GB free on /home.

## Order
fetch -> stats (P3 inputs) -> P3 -> classical r7 -> P2 -> classical r32 -> P2b -> P4 -> P5 -> P6 -> P7 -> P8'.
P3 comes first in time because the classical run needs a calibration; P2b is still the first gate read for
the Q1 condition. Recording 32's classical run is needed because P2b asks about "at least one recording" and
the decision rule needs both. No parameter is set from recording 32: thresholds, windows and rendering are
those written here. No network sees recording 32 in any pilot.

## P3: calibration
Per-block photon_transfer (500-frame blocks, E58's fit).
GO: in each recording, every block's offset is within +-20 ADU and slope within +-10% of that recording's
median; and the two recordings' medians differ by at most 20 ADU and 10%.
NO-GO: calibrate per block and per recording. On GO the classical run uses each recording's median values.
Report E58's slope 13.86 and offset 457 beside them.

## P2: classical on recording 7
Pipeline: E58's detect, blob_patches, count_emitters, localisation_table unchanged (Kmax 4), except the
background: a rolling temporal median, one H x W background per 100 frames, each from the 201 frames
centred on that sub-block (clipped at the ends of the movie), with detect's 5-MAD threshold computed per
sub-block. One chunk per 500 frames. Prior logb from that sub-block's median background.
GO needs all of:
(a) stage wall time under 20 min on 13 workers; (b) whole-tree peak under 20 GB (memguard cap 20);
(c) drift residual under 10 nm: localisations in 1,000-frame blocks, odd frames and even frames rendered
separately on a 0.25 px grid over the whole field, cross-correlated to the all-frames render of the other
parity. Drift estimated from odd frames, applied to even frames, re-estimated on even frames: the rms over
blocks of the per-axis residual shift is the number, in nm.
NO-GO on time: K = 1 with overlaps flagged. NO-GO on drift: restrict to correctable frames, say so.

## P2b: is there a decision, and are overlaps common?
Filter: E58's sd under 30 nm, drift corrected with the all-frames estimate. Mask share over 0.5.
Merging: links gap 1, radius 1.5 px are merged to events (weighted mean), as the plan's FRC fix requires.
FRC: events inside the mask rendered at 10 nm, Hann-tapered edge of the mask's bounding box, two halves by
50-frame time blocks (alternating), threshold 1/7. Band: time-block bootstrap, 200 draws per N, blocks
resampled within each half so no block lands in both, each draw jittered by each event's sd (the plan's
"localisation error propagated"); 95% quantiles. Point values from the unjittered, unresampled data.
Cluster count (Q3 default): events inside the mask on the 10 nm grid, one-step cross dilation, 8-connected
components, components with at least 7 events counted. Largest component's share of events reported; over
0.5 at 15,000 frames marks the readout saturated.
Grid N: 2000, 3000, 4000, 5000, 6000, 7500, 9000, 10500, 12000, 13500, 15000. Each N is the first N frames.
A recording's N* is the smallest grid N at which FRC and count are within 10% of their 15,000 values and the
bands overlap, at that N and every larger grid N. "Flattens before 15,000" means N* is at most 13,500.
Both answers count as a pass on the curve (the plan's wording): the curve gate fails only if it cannot be
computed.

Overlap, primary number (chosen because P1 showed K of 2 or more is inflated on real data, 51% against 17%
simulated, and the detector's direct count is deflated by merging): for each detected blob centred inside
the mask, count detected blobs in the same frame at 4-8 px, anywhere in the field. If n is the mean count,
the Poisson-area estimate of the share with a neighbour under 4 px is 1 - exp(-n/3). Clustering below 4 px
makes this a lower bound, wings cannot reach it, merging does not touch it.
Secondary, reported beside it, none gating: detector's direct under-4-px share; share of blobs with chosen
K of 2 or more; share with two emitters both over 500 photons and 1-4 px apart; the plan's Poisson 7% basis.
All per recording, plus by frame range 0-2000 and 10000-15000.

**Rare means the primary number is under 5% in both recordings.** Rare means stopped = true and FULL does not
go, whatever else passes (Q1 default). If the curve is also settled, this is the plan's no-go verbatim.
If only one recording is under 5%, not rare, but say so.
P4-P7 and P8' still run in either case: Q1's default says stop before FULL, FULL's price is asked for, and
pilots P4-P7 are 5,000 steps at most. If the owner's Q1 answer changes this it costs under an hour.

## P4: throughput
Base 32, depth 3 levels, 3-frame input, 8 outputs, batch 16, 64 x 64 crops, simulator inside the JIT, Adam
with clipping, float32. Time 500 steps on GPU, compile excluded, block_until_ready on loss and weights. Then
100 steps on CPU on 13 CPUs, in a separate process with JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu.
GO: at least 30 steps/s; VRAM peak under 8 GB (vram_high_water). 15-30: accept, say so. Under 15: pre-simulate
or lower batch. Under 8: simplify.
Sampler check (plan section 5): 2,000,000 Wilson-Hilferty float32 JAX draws against exact Poisson-Gamma plus
read noise: TV at most 0.030 at 20 photons, at most 0.015 at 88 photons. Over those: report, use
exact draws for pixels under 88 photons.

## P5: learning
Up to 5,000 steps, base 32, version A priors. Validation is on simulation only, E58's sparse setup: 0.089
per um^2, 2,000 photons, E58's background, 100 frames at 200 x 200 not used in training.
GO: recall at least 0.90 at 2,000 photons, match radius 2 px; x-y RMSE of matches within 1.3 x the CRLB of
E58's forward model at that brightness and background; no NaN in any step or output.
NO-GO: debug at this size, do not scale up. A retrain after a bug is allowed and reported as a lapse if the
gate above is then what it passes. The gate does not change.
SMALL-rung check, reported, no gate number: 1,500 steps of base 16 at the same validation.

## P6: inference
500 full recording-7 frames at 200 x 200, mixed start, middle, end, GPU, checksum over all output maps so XLA
cannot remove work. No recording-32 frame.
GO: at least 50 frames/s; no tile seams: this is whole-frame, so the check is the 8-px grid. Mean p by
(x mod 8, y mod 8) on real frames: max over min at most 1.25. NO-GO: tile with overlap; CPU pool as fallback.

## P7: NUTS audit
20 spots from the recording-7 mask, 10 with K = 1 and 10 with K = 2, nutpie, E58's spot_model, JAX_PLATFORMS=cpu,
BLAS one thread, PYTENSOR_FLAGS=base_compiledir in the scratch folder, ~/.pytensor untouched.
GO: r_hat at most 1.01 and zero divergences across all 20; 200 spots extrapolate to under 10 min on 13 CPUs.
NO-GO: fewer spots, or E58's Laplace fit audited by a smaller NUTS set.

## P8': replaces P8 (Q9 default)
A short training job, 3,000 steps, checkpoint every 1,000, killed with SIGKILL after step 2,000 was saved, then
resumed from the checkpoint. A separate uninterrupted run is the reference.
GO: resume starts at the last saved step; loss lost under 1,000 steps of work; at step 3,000 every logged loss after
the resume is within 1e-3 relative of the reference, and the weights' relative L2 difference is under 1e-3.
No soak. This job is about 3 minutes.

## Q8 relative line, set before any network result was seen
On the paired test, at gap 3, radius 1.5 px, primary estimate chosen K (the plan's default), with K = 1 reported beside it, on
matched brightness: the network is "no worse than classical" if its z sd is at most the classical z sd on the
same matched set, and "worse" if it exceeds it by over 10%. The absolute lines 1.0-1.15 and over 1.25 stand
beside this. Both go in the notebook. Q7: 95% half-width and one se side by side.

## FULL decision
go = true needs: P2, P3 pass or their no-go handled; overlaps not rare; P4 at least 15 steps/s; P5, P6, P7 and P8'
pass; offline 10,26 and machine checks 1 throughout. Otherwise go = false and the reason is stated.
